mapper.select: SELECT ls.id AS "id", 'manual' AS "source", ls.schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = ls.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = ls.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(ls.actual_qty, ls.order_qty) AS "orderQty", ls.order_qty AS "plannedQty", ls.actual_qty AS "actualQty", ls.note AS "note", ls.lot_id AS "lotId", ls.ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", ps.schedule_date AS "lotDate", ps.lot_no AS "lotNo" FROM logistics_schedule ls LEFT JOIN production_schedule ps ON ps.id = ls.lot_id WHERE ls.schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY ls.sort_order, ls.id

SELECT p.id AS "id", 'production' AS "source", p.logistics_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = p.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = p.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(p.logistics_actual_qty, p.actual_qty, p.order_qty) AS "orderQty", p.order_qty AS "plannedQty", p.logistics_actual_qty AS "actualQty", p.note AS "note", p.ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", p.schedule_date AS "lotDate", p.lot_no AS "lotNo" FROM production_schedule p WHERE p.logistics_date = #{date} AND (COALESCE(p.ship_confirmed, 0) != 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_schedule l WHERE l.lot_id = p.id)) ORDER BY p.id

SELECT a.shipment_id AS "shipmentId", a.lot_id AS "lotId", a.qty AS "qty", p.lot_no AS "lotNo", p.schedule_date AS "lotDate" FROM shipment_lot_allocation a JOIN logistics_schedule ls ON ls.id = a.shipment_id LEFT JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = a.lot_id WHERE a.shipment_table = 'logistics_schedule' AND ls.schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY p.schedule_date, a.id
SELECT id FROM production_schedule WHERE source_order_id = #{sourceOrderId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logistics_schedule ( schedule_date, client_code, product_code, order_qty, note, lot_id, source_order_id, sort_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{scheduleDate}, #{clientCode}, #{productCode}, #{orderQty}, #{note}, #{lotId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sourceOrderId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT ls.id AS "id", ls.lot_id AS "lotId", ls.source_order_id AS "sourceOrderId", ls.ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", ls.actual_qty AS "actualQty", ls.order_qty AS "orderQty", p.lot_no AS "lotNo", p.schedule_date AS "lotDate" FROM logistics_schedule ls LEFT JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = ls.lot_id WHERE ls.id = #{id}

SELECT a.shipment_id AS "shipmentId", a.lot_id AS "lotId", a.qty AS "qty", p.lot_no AS "lotNo", p.schedule_date AS "lotDate" FROM shipment_lot_allocation a LEFT JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = a.lot_id WHERE a.shipment_table = 'logistics_schedule' AND a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY p.schedule_date, a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_lot_allocation ( shipment_table, shipment_id, lot_id, qty, created_at ) VALUES ( 'logistics_schedule', #{shipmentId}, #{lotId}, #{qty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", actual_qty AS "actualQty", order_qty AS "orderQty", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", lot_no AS "lotNo" FROM production_schedule WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) = #{productName} ORDER BY schedule_date, id

SELECT a.lot_id AS "lotId", SUM(a.qty) AS "qty" FROM shipment_lot_allocation a JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = a.lot_id WHERE a.shipment_table = 'logistics_schedule' AND (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = p.product_code) = #{productName} GROUP BY a.lot_id

SELECT ls.id AS "id", ls.lot_id AS "lotId", ls.actual_qty AS "actualQty", ls.order_qty AS "orderQty", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_lot_allocation a WHERE a.shipment_table = 'logistics_schedule' AND a.shipment_id = ls.id) AS "allocated" FROM logistics_schedule ls JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = ls.lot_id WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = p.product_code) = #{productName}

SELECT id AS "id", logistics_actual_qty AS "logisticsActualQty", order_qty AS "orderQty", ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed" FROM production_schedule WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) = #{productName} AND logistics_date IS NOT NULL AND logistics_date != ''

SELECT id AS "id", order_date AS "orderDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = sales_order.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = sales_order.product_code) AS "productName", order_qty AS "orderQty", note AS "note", production_date AS "productionDate", logistics_date AS "logisticsDate" FROM sales_order WHERE (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = sales_order.product_code) = #{productName} AND imported_production = 0 ORDER BY production_date, sort_order, id

SELECT id AS "id", order_date AS "orderDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = sales_order.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = sales_order.product_code) AS "productName", order_qty AS "orderQty", note AS "note", production_date AS "productionDate", logistics_date AS "logisticsDate" FROM sales_order WHERE logistics_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND imported_shipment = 0 ORDER BY logistics_date, sort_order, id
